item.title: Malaysia Has Up To Five Months’ Medicine Stock, Says MOH
item.description:
Source: CodeBlue (Malaysia Health)
MOH says it has 1-3 months of medicine stock supplies, supported by additional buffer stock of up to 2 months by its concessionaire. Local pharmaceutical manufacturers have up to 3 months' raw material stock and about 2 months' stock of finished products. item.title: Fruit And Vegetable Prices In Malaysia Set To Rise: Farmers
item.description:
Source: CodeBlue (Malaysia Health)
Farmers' groups warn of increases in the prices of fruits and vegetables in Malaysia due to fertiliser shortages and diesel costs, amid the Iran war. Vegetable prices are expected to soar by 50% in one or two weeks and fruits by 20% in three to six months. item.title: Malaysia Vulnerable To Fertiliser Import Disruptions, Says RSIS
item.description:
Source: CodeBlue (Malaysia Health)
RSIS says Malaysia is vulnerable to fertiliser import disruption from the Iran war as Malaysia’s domestic fertiliser production can only meet 39% of annual fertiliser use. Second wave impact is LNG trade disruption; LNG is a critical input to produce urea. The post Malaysia Vulnerable To Fertiliser Import Disruptions, Says RSIS appeared first on CodeBlue .
